gloss: to become hoarse; to become raspy

definitions.gloss: to become hoarse; to become raspy
definitions.explanation: For one's voice to become rough, harsh, or gravelly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しゃがれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しゃがれてしまった。
examples.english: My voice became hoarse from a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{叫|さけ}び→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧たせい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しゃがれて、⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{出|で}なく→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: From shouting for a long time, my voice became so hoarse that it could barely come out.

notes:
Describes the quality of a voice that has become rough or gravelly. Most commonly appears in the た-form as しゃがれた⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (a hoarse voice). Can describe a temporary condition (from a cold, shouting, etc.) or a permanent vocal quality (an older person's gravelly voice). Sometimes written in katakana: シャガレる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しゃがれた⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a hoarse/raspy voice
- しゃがれ{声|ごえ}: hoarse voice (compound form)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧しゃがれる: one's voice becomes hoarse
- {酒焼|さけや}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しゃがれた⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: voice hoarse from heavy drinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {嗄|か}れる: to become hoarse — more formal/written; specifically about voice loss
- ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧: to dry up; to wither — when used for voice (⟦{声|こえ}が{枯|か}れる→声が枯れる：27199_koegakareru⟧), means the voice has dried out from overuse
- ハスキーな: husky — a loanword with a more positive, attractive connotation
